providers.name: GitHub Actions
providers.best_for: Run an occasional isolated UAT flow without maintaining a server.
providers.reason: The repository is already on GitHub, and every run receives a fresh x64 Ubuntu runner with Docker.
providers.free_tier: Standard runners are free for public repositories; private repositories use the account's included monthly minutes.
limitations: Private-repository standard runners currently provide 8 GB RAM and 14 GB SSD, so run one flow at a time.
The runner is destroyed after the job and cannot retain a failed Docker environment for interactive diagnosis.
